questions.question: The person who lives in the center of household life derives material benefits by performing religious rituals, fulfilling his desire for economic development and what?
questions.explanation: "The person who lives in the center of household life derives material benefits by performing religious rituals, and thereby he fulfills his desire for economic development and sense gratification." (SB 3.32.1)

questions.question: To which planet can materialistic persons devoted to the forefathers and demigods be elevated, where they drink an extract of the soma plant?
questions.explanation: "Such materialistic persons, attracted by sense gratification and devoted to the forefathers and demigods, can be elevated to the moon, where they drink an extract of the soma plant." (SB 3.32.3)

questions.question: All the planets of materialistic persons, including the heavenly planets, are vanquished when the Supreme Lord Hari goes to His bed of serpents, known as what?
questions.explanation: "All the planets of the materialistic persons, including all the heavenly planets, such as the moon, are vanquished when the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Hari, goes to His bed of serpents, which is known as Ananta Sesa." (SB 3.32.4)

questions.question: Those who are intelligent and of purified consciousness are completely satisfied in what?
questions.explanation: "Those who are intelligent and are of purified consciousness are completely satisfied in Krsna consciousness." (SB 3.32.5)

questions.question: By executing one's occupational duties with detachment and without false egoism, what can one easily enter into?
questions.explanation: "By thus executing so-called material duties he can easily enter into the kingdom of God." (SB 3.32.6)

questions.question: Worshipers of the Hiranyagarbha expansion of the Personality of Godhead remain within the material world until the end of two of what, when Lord Brahma also dies?
questions.explanation: "Worshipers of the Hiranyagarbha expansion of the Personality of Godhead remain within this material world until the end of two pararddhas, when Lord Brahma also dies." (SB 3.32.8)

questions.question: Yogis who give up their bodies after reaching the planet of Brahma enter into whose body and can then enter the kingdom of God when he is liberated?
questions.explanation: "After giving up their bodies, they enter into the body of Lord Brahma, and therefore when Brahma is liberated and goes to the Supreme Personality of Godhead, who is the Supreme Brahman, such yogis can also enter into the kingdom of God." (SB 3.32.10)

questions.question: Lord Kapila advises his mother to take direct shelter, by devotional service, of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, who is seated where?
questions.explanation: "By devotional service take direct shelter of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, who is seated in everyone's heart." (SB 3.32.11)

questions.question: To what are persons who give up hearing of the Lord and indulge in hearing abominable materialistic activities compared?
questions.explanation: "Because they are averse to the nectar of the activities of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, they are compared to stool-eating hogs." (SB 3.32.19)

questions.question: By which course of the sun are materialistic persons allowed to go to the planet called Pitriloka?
questions.explanation: "Such materialistic persons are allowed to go to the planet called Pitrloka by the southern course of the sun, but they again come back to this planet." (SB 3.32.20)

questions.question: When the results of their pious activities are exhausted, what happens to those raised to a high position?

options.text: They fall down and come back to this planet

questions.explanation: "When the results of their pious activities are exhausted, they fall down by higher arrangement and again come back to this planet, just as any person raised to a high position sometimes all of a sudden falls." (SB 3.32.21)

questions.question: The Supreme Personality of Godhead alone is complete transcendental knowledge, but according to different processes of understanding He appears as impersonal Brahman, as Paramatma, as the Supreme Personality of Godhead, or as what?
questions.explanation: "He appears differently, either as impersonal Brahman, as Paramatma, as the Supreme Personality of Godhead or as the purusa-avatara." (SB 3.32.26)

questions.question: What is the greatest common understanding for all yogis, achievable by different kinds of yoga?
questions.explanation: "The greatest common understanding for all yogis is complete detachment from matter, which can be achieved by different kinds of yoga." (SB 3.32.27)

questions.question: Philosophical research culminates in understanding whom?
questions.explanation: "Philosophical research culminates in understanding the Supreme Personality of Godhead." (SB 3.32.32)

questions.question: Lord Kapila says he has explained the process of devotional service and its identity in how many social divisions?
questions.explanation: "I have explained to you the process of devotional service and its identity in four different social divisions." (SB 3.32.37)

questions.question: For whom is this confidential instruction NOT meant?

options.text: The envious, agnostics, and those unclean in behavior
Those respectful to the spiritual master
Those friendly to all living entities

questions.explanation: "This instruction is not meant for the envious, for the agnostics or for persons who are unclean in their behavior." (SB 3.32.39)

questions.question: According to Lord Kapila, what is the result for anyone who once meditates upon Him with faith and affection and hears and chants about Him?

options.text: He surely goes back home, back to Godhead

questions.explanation: "Anyone who once meditates upon Me with faith and affection, who hears and chants about Me, surely goes back home, back to Godhead." (SB 3.32.43)
